text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
{0} is taking a stroll
through Landosol's plaza on a certain summer's day.
text_block_list.orig_text:
夏のある日、
{0}はランドソルの広場を散歩していた。

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: Oh! There you are!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ～
いたいた！

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
I've been looking for you! I thought it'd be easy,
but I forgot how elusive you can be!
Running all over the city made for good exercise, though! ♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
捜したよ～！　
すぐに見つかるかと思ったけど、
{0}は神出鬼没だからね～
ランドソル中走り回って
いい運動になったさ～♪

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
Hm? You'll wipe the sweat off for me?
Aha! You're super thoughtful. ♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
ん？　
汗を拭いてくれるの～？
あは～、
{0}は気が利くさ～♪

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: Let's get going!
text_block_list.orig_text: じゃあ行くさ～！

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: You'll see when we get there!
text_block_list.orig_text: いいからいいから～♪

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: Don't sweat it, don't sweat it! ♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
なんくるない、
なんくるない～♪

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: Aaand we're here!
text_block_list.orig_text: と～ちゃ～くさ～！

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
Hm? What's up?
You look super surprised.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ん？　
どうしたの～？
ハブを踏んづけたみたいな顔しちゃって～？

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
Oh, did you think I was gonna drag you to a volcano again?
Nah. Volcanoes are way too hot in the summer.
text_block_list.orig_text:
前みたいに
火山にでも行くのかと思った？
今日は違うよ～、
夏に火山は暑すぎるからね～♪

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
There's gonna be a dance party at that stage over there today.
Everyone's gonna feast, go wild and dance like they've never danced before!
text_block_list.orig_text:
今日はね、
そこのステージでダンスパーティがあるんさ～
みんなが食べて騒いで、
踊りまくる宴だよー

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
Truth is... they asked me to perform, too!
I'm gonna be using an instrument from my homeland! ♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
実はそこで、
演奏を頼まれたんさ～
故郷の楽器を使って、
私が演奏するんだよ～♪

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
That's why I brought you here.
I want you to hear me perform as well. ♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
それで{0}にも演奏を聴いてもらおうと思って、
ここまで連れてきたわけさ～♪

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
Actually, did you have any other plans today?
Sorry. I was just so happy when I found you that
I kinda forced you into coming along.
choice_data_list: I've never had plans in my life.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……そういえば、
結構強引に連れてきちゃったけど、
他に用事とかなかった？　
{0}を見つけたのが
うれしくて、
つい突っ走っちゃったよ～

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
Great!
Kasumi's always yelling at me about stopping to think before I act.
text_block_list.orig_text:
よかった～
勢いだけで動くなって、
カスミにもよく言われるんだけどね～

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
Really? Then I'll bring you along whenever something comes up! ♪
Not a problem if you're free, right?
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうなの～？　
ならこれから何かあるときは、
どんどん{0}を連れて行くさ～♪
暇ならいいよね～？

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
Man, that's a relief!
Okay, okay. I'm gonna go get changed!
No point in being at the beach if you're not in a swimsuit! ♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
ホッとしたさ～！
じゃあじゃあ、
私は着替えてくるね～
海と言えば、
水着だからね～♪

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: Sorry for the wait!
text_block_list.orig_text: お待たせ～！

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
The sunlight feels so nice on my skin! ♪
Hm? You look kinda puzzled.
text_block_list.orig_text:
日差しが肌に直接当たって
気持ちいいね～♪
ん？　
不思議そうな顔してどうしたさ～？

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
There's not that much difference?
Hey, that's not true!
text_block_list.orig_text:
いつもとあまり変わらない？
そんなことないよ～？

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
There's less fabric, plus the material's different.
Come on, give it a touch! ♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
布も少ないし、
生地の材質も違うんだよー？
ほらほら、
触ってみて～♪

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
Totally different, right?
Yup, yup. Glad you agree. ♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
ねぇ～、
違うでしょ～？
うんうん、
分かってもらえてよかったさ～♪

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
Hm. Feels like I can hear the sea calling for me now.
Listen close. It's begging me to go for a swim!
text_block_list.orig_text:
う～ん、
水着になると
海の声が聞こえる気がするね～
ほら、
おいでおいで～
って言ってるさ～

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
I won't, though. I've gotta hold back the urge.
The party's tonight, so I need to get to practicing!
text_block_list.orig_text:
でも、
海に飛び込みたい気持ちはグッと我慢我慢。
パーティは夜からだから、
今のうちに練習しておかないとね～！

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
This is the instrument I'll be using.
It's called a sanshin. Funny shape, right?
text_block_list.orig_text:
これが今日、
演奏する楽器だよ～
三線っていうわけさ～、
面白い形でしょ～？

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
All the kids back home are taught how to play it by their grandparents.
People, animals and even monsters'll start dancing if I play it!
text_block_list.orig_text:
故郷の子供はみんな
おじいおばあから弾き方を習うんさ～
私が演奏すれば、
人でも動物でも、
魔物だって踊りだすよ～♪

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: Lemme give it a test run!
text_block_list.orig_text:
それじゃ、
ちょっと試しに弾いてみるさ～

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: Oh!
text_block_list.orig_text: あ！

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
Oops.
I didn't expect one of the strings to break.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あちゃ～
ちょうど、弦が切れちゃったね～

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
I replace them pretty frequently, y'know.
Sucky timing.
text_block_list.orig_text:
交換はこまめにやってたんだけどね～？
タイミング悪いさ～

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Then again, it could have broken in the middle of the performance,
so I guess it was good timing?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ん？　
でも本番で切れるよりはよかったのかな～？
タイミングよかったのかも～？

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
Ahhh... I forgot that I didn't bring any spare strings.
Hm... Now I'm in a pickle.
choice_data_list: Think anyone else would have a spare?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ～
でも、
替えの弦を持ってきてないんだった～
う～ん。
でーじ困ったさ～

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: Anyone... else?
text_block_list.orig_text:
誰か……
誰か？

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: That's it!
text_block_list.orig_text: それさ～！

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: Should be around here somewhere!
text_block_list.orig_text:
確かこの辺りに、
いるはずさ～

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: GRUOOOGHHHH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: There it is!
text_block_list.orig_text: いたいた～♪

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
This critter's whiskers are real strong and durable.
They're the perfect replacement for an instrument's strings! ♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
この子の髭は頑丈でしなやかで、
楽器の弦に使うのにぴったりなんだよ～♪

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
Look how bushy it is, too.
It's so adorable.
text_block_list.orig_text:
見た目もふさふさ～
してて、
かわいいでしょ～？

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: SKRRREEE!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
Hm? You think I'm in danger? Don't worry!
It's just wary of people. It won't actually harm anyone. ♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
ん？　
危ない？　
大丈夫さ～
この子は警戒心が強いだけで、
攻撃的ではないんだよ～♪

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
Definitely doesn't seem like it'll happily give me
one of its whiskers if I ask politely, though.
text_block_list.orig_text:
でも、
髭をくださ～い、
って言って
通じる雰囲気じゃないね～

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
But that's where this comes in!
Ta-da! Sanshin time! ♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
そこで、
これさ～！
三線の出番だよ～♪

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: It's missing a string, but it should still do the trick. ♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
弦が一本切れてるけど、
これを鳴らせば～♪

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: GRAAAGGGHHH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──ギャオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
Look. It's nice and docile now.
Seems like these types of monsters can feel sounds through their whiskers.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ほら、
大人しくなったでしょ～？
この子たち、
このたくさんある長い髭で
音を感じるらしいんさ～

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: You can communicate with them by playing music like this. ♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
こうしていい音を聴かせれば、
気持ちが通じるんだよ～♪

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: GRAAAGGGHHH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──ギャオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: Aha! That tickles! ♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
あは～、
くすぐったいさ～♪

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: So, mind if I take one of your whiskers?
text_block_list.orig_text:
それじゃあ、
ちょこっとだけ髭を貰っていいかな～？

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: GRAAAGGGHHH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──ギャオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
Thanks so much!
I'll get this strung up in a jiffy.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ありがと～、
助かるさ～！
それじゃ、
ここで弦を交換しちゃうね～

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
Just gotta twist these parts around,
wrap and tie it all up,
set the bridge up, and then do some tuning.
text_block_list.orig_text:
これを縒り合わせて、
こっちを巻いて、
こっちは結んで、
あとはウマを立てて、
音をちょいちょい～
と合わせれば～

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
There we go!
Back to normal!
Actually, it sounds even better than it used to!
text_block_list.orig_text:
完成～♪
これで元通り、
ううん、
前よりもいい音になったさ～！

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: Lemme give it a test run. ♪
text_block_list.orig_text: ちょっと弾いてみるね～♪

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
Makes your body wanna dance on its own, doesn't it?
Don't fight it. Just let it happen. ♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
どう～？　
体が勝手に動いちゃうさ～？
我慢せず、
踊っていいんだよ～♪

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: GRUOOOGHHHH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: Look. That's how you do it! ♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
ほら、
こっちはノリノリだよ～♪

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
And thus a comforting melody resounded through
the forest for a brief period of time.
text_block_list.orig_text:
それからしばらくの間、
森の中に心地よい音色が響き渡るのだった。
